newsitem.title: USA: Brown & Sharpe names new directors.
newsitem.headline: Brown & Sharpe names new directors.

text.p: Brown & Sharpe Manufacturing Co said Friday four new people have joined its board of directors, replacing others who resigned from the board.
The new lineup comes five months after the company's longtime chairman, Henry Sharpe, resigned and was replaced by Frank Curtin, who also is the company's president and chief executive.

Joining the board are Harry Hammerly, retired executive vice president of 3M Corp ; John Robert Held, former president and chief executive of Chipcom Corp; Roger Levien, vice president corporate research and technology, Xerox Corp.

Besides Sharpe, resigning as directors are: Vincenzo Cannatelli, president and chief executive of Elsag Bailey SpA; Albert deBenedictis, senior vice president/corporate development of Finmeccanica SpA ; and Enrico Albareto, chief executive of Elsag Bailey SpA.
